mathematical_result: Every original matching stratum has one selected control per target. Target-node incidence has exactly one unit entry per row in a distinct column, so Z_target Z_target.T = I. All mask/quality subsets retain this identity. Under a uniform residual diagonal the target-node variance is confounded with residual scale; it must not be reported as a separate identified variance component.
scope: Complete direct scan of closed original 4,250,692 selection links, with archive/link checksum verification. This does not imply independence of physical models/genes/backgrounds or identity of the global pooled-case target kernel. Nonuniform residual diagonals and other weighting/loading definitions require separate covariance-basis qualification. No variance components or biological effects estimated.
